keyVerseDR: "This is the day which the Lord hath made: let us be glad and rejoice therein." (Ps 118:24)

level1.title: This Week's Catholic Virtue: Zest
level1.story: Zest means living with energy and joy. Each day is a gift from God to enjoy!
level1.keyLine: This is the day the Lord has made!
level1.heartIntro: Hang this sheet on the fridge and practice zest all week. On Saturday, talk together, write what you practiced, and a parent signs.
questions: What made us excited and full of energy this week?
How can we enjoy each day as God's gift?
actions: Hang this sheet on the fridge
level1.prayer: Lord, thank You for this new day. Help me live it with joy and energy for You. Amen.

activity.title: Daily Action Checklist
activity.intro: Color a star each day, Monday through Saturday. Hang this sheet on the fridge and practice with your family. A parent signs at the end of the week.
items: MON: Wake up and say, 'Good morning, God!'
TUE: Play outside with all your energy
WED: Help with a chore cheerfully
THU: Sing a happy song to Jesus
FRI: Do something fun as a family
SAT: Try your best at something new

level2.title: This Week's Catholic Virtue: Zest
level2.story: Zest means living with energy, excitement, and interest. People with zest wake up ready for the day and put their whole heart into what they do. They do not do things halfway. The psalm says that this is the day the Lord has made, so let us be glad! Zest comes from knowing that every day is a gift from God to use well.
level2.keyLine: This is the day the Lord has made!
level2.heartIntro: Hang this sheet on the fridge and practice zest all week. On Saturday, talk together, write what you practiced, and a parent signs.
questions: What made us excited and full of energy this week?
How did God help us grow in zest?
actions: Hang this sheet on the fridge
level2.prayer: Lord, thank You for this new day. Help me live it with joy and energy for You. Amen.

activity.title: Daily Action Checklist
activity.intro: Color a star each day, Monday through Saturday. Hang this sheet on the fridge and practice with your family. A parent signs at the end of the week.
items: MON: Start the day with a morning offering
TUE: Get exercise or play a sport
WED: Do a task with your whole heart
THU: Get enough sleep to be ready for tomorrow
FRI: Share your excitement with someone
SAT: Plan a joyful family activity for Sunday
